<subject>OreX Solutions...The New Mantra to Reduce IT Spending</subject>
<body>
Dear Darren,

Speed, adaptability, and continuous productivity are the hallmarks of OreX Solutions. Our agile and scalable on/off-site, 24/7 remote operations model supports a comprehensive range of managed services—from mine planning software support, system enhancements, and modernization through to complete IT infrastructure management, including data centre administration.

We can offer Tasman Ridge our Certified Microsoft and OreX Solutions specialists at A$25/hr to assist with your initiatives. We have nearly 500 experts and cutting-edge technical hubs. Our Innovation Centres in Perth are regarded as the flagship facilities of OreX and a key differentiator for you.

https://www.orexsolutions.com.au/

Over the years, our Global Technology Centres (GTCs) in Perth have delivered an outstanding track record of project success for our Australian, European, and Asian clients.

Our Innovation Centres (ICs) and GTCs provide the following capabilities for our customers:

   a. Custom Mining Software Development  
   b. Data Analytics and Reporting Services  
   c. Application Re-engineering and Modernization  
   d. System Migration and Integration Services  
   e. 24x7 Technical Support and Service Desk  

While all services can be delivered from any of our Innovation Centres, clients gain significant benefits by leveraging the scale and flexibility of our offshore development teams. Please visit https://www.orexsolutions.com.au/

This round-the-clock development and delivery approach allows OreX to rapidly scale project staffing to meet client demands, facilitate concurrent workflows, and effectively operate a virtual 24-hour work cycle on client projects.

Darren, please let us know if we can arrange a brief meeting to discuss these details further. Looking forward to your reply.

Regards,

Martha Soto  
martha.soto@tasmanridge.com.au
